_doc: Per-product "what's new" — inline text, never a clickable link (product repos are private on GitHub, a link would break for a public visitor). Hand-maintained from releases marked publique="Oui" in feature-factory/data/<id>/releases.json. Order: most recent first, ~2-3 entries max per product.

barcelona.texte: New Training Path mode: 55 multiple-choice questions organized into campaigns unlocked at a 70% pass score.
Configurable password screen to protect access during playtesting.
Three learning tiers for the options wheel strategy.

madrid.texte: New per-stock analysis panel (winners/losers, dividends, invested vs. recovered, country/sector breakdown) and an Auto/Light/Dark theme switch now fully aligned with the shared design system.
